data.name: PURGE - Three vs Blood
data.detailed_description:
PURGE - Three vs Blood: A classic wave-based zombie game.


PURGE - Three vs Blood offers a challenging arena zombie apocalypse where you and up to 3 players face relentless hordes of ravenous zombies. Unlock ranks, explore various maps, and choose unique characters. A wide range of weapons and traps is at your disposal!

Are you ready? Your attention will be pushed to its limits. How many waves can you survive? Fight the hostile zombie horde alone or in co-op mode with friends. Your mission is to hold back the hungry zombies for as long as possible. With each wave, the zombies become stronger. Earn points and exchange them for new weapons, traps, and other resources.

Always be ready to help your teammates. When a player is injured, you will hear the pounding of their heart. You only have a few seconds to save them, otherwise they will be lost forever until you complete your current wave.

Single-player and Multiplayer Mode


Single-player
Multiplayer co-op mode for up to 3 players
Online connection: P2P network

Progression and Ranking System


PURGE - Three vs Blood includes a progression and ranking system. Once you reach a certain level, you will be assigned a rank. The better you perform, the higher your rank. Each rank unlocks additional playable characters and maps. More information can be found in the game description.

Dying multiple times or being injured in the game may result in point loss and the loss of your rank.

Difficulty


  • Difficulty scales according to the number of players.

Complex Character Mechanics


  • Various character selections
  • Realistic body movements

Weather System


  • Random weather effects such as rain and fog

Dynamic Day and Night Cycle

  • Featuring an immersive soundscape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64Bit
  • Processor: AMD FX Six Core / Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 940 2GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Online Connection: P2P-Network

  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64Bit
  • Processor: AMD FX Six Core / Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / NVIDIA GTX 1080 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
